answer: Re-attestations are stored in crystal and pearl lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the kernel graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1716 impostors cost 1432 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
